'''Veris''' was a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]], [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who underwent surgery to make her look like a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]], and she acted as a double for [[Ushka Et]], the Devaronian leader singer of the band [[Distraction]]. After Distraction became scheduled to hold a concert aboard the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Sleemo Poya Jeedai]]'', Veris and doubles of the other band members traveled to the yacht, as part of a security ploy. However, the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Niklas Cories]] planned to attack the ''Sleemo Poya Jeedai'' during the concert, so he [[Death/Legends|killed]] Veris and captured Et, allowing him to disguise himself as Et and infiltrate the concert.
